top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a distinct, specific invention: magic-wavelength trapping of neutral atoms in an optical lattice, which cancels the lattice light shift and brought optical clocks to the 10^-18 level. The result is reproduced and intercompared by independent laboratories and species, and the two-name allocation to Katori and Ye is compact and defensible, with a citation that separates it from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. P002 is excellent and mature as phenomenology, but the experimental credit omits Yuan Cao, first author of the 2018 experiments, and the pairing mechanism remains unresolved, so I rank it second and above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my astroparticle background is near B012 but that is not part of any proposal on the slate, and no tie to Katori, Ye, MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero or Bistritzer is recorded
